coverage.assessment: Three setups are weakened. The window-and-moon trigger loses its motivation (revision). The 'people wait ages' setup for the 35-minute car purchase is gone (first draft). The climb and alias rationales are cut, so a 'So' connective is left without its premise (revision).
Locations, the Wednesday/Friday timeline, the nurse's back and unheard words, the second nurse '(not Whittington's one)', Hall naming his nursing home himself, and Julius's lameness all remain clear.

Attribution stays clear throughout. Two compressions cost something. The mutual 'where is he?' exchange is cut. So is the 'Where shall I begin?' beat that shows Julius obeying Tuppence. Both are defensible.

Julius's 'if the girl was really Whittington's niece' doubt is removed. Cutting the ricked-foot detail makes 'so' tie his return to Tommy's silence. Julius's guessing 'I guess it was whether it was raining' is also lost.
There is no hint that the nurse was Jane. Hall's literal 'No' and the Nurse Edith departure stay unemphasized, which preserves fair play.

The revision removes several idiomatic flourishes the first draft kept: the 'skunk'/gun line, 'almighty cold', 'mighty slippery' and 'climb down ignominiously'. This edges the yarn toward the flat summary the plan warns against.
Julius's doubts about Carter and lawyers stay unexplained, keeping both readings open. Tuppence's trust in Sir James and her 'prejudishish' coinage survive.
All five local endpoints are intact. In partner 013 the revision drops the Rolls-Royce mention. That is a partner-side loss and is not charged to 012.

strengths: All seven verbatim anchors survive in context, including the shadow reveal and Julius's self-mocking fall.
Hall's literal 'No' and the Nurse Edith departure are kept flat and unemphasized, preserving fair play.
Julius's 'Just an idea of mine' and his sharp rejection of lawyers remain unexplained, keeping the double reading open.
The car-purchase coda keeps its 'Well?' / 'he got out' rhythm.
summary: The revision keeps the chapter's structure, all seven verbatim lines, the continuity checks and every local dependency endpoint. The losses are cumulative trims to Julius's yarn. Some thin his American idiom. Others remove small links in the physical and causal chain: why the nurse goes to the window, Julius's doubt about the 'niece', the foot healing, and the rationales for the climb and the alias. The waiting-list setup for the Rolls-Royce punchline was already cut in the first draft. No blocker; small restorations are recommended.
